name: wordpress-remastered
description: Development harness for the WordPress Remastered distribution: boots a real WordPress via wp-env with the plugin and block theme active, and tests it at the browser level with Playwright.
author: Bagus Pamungkas

scripts.env:activate: node scripts/wp-env.cjs run cli wp theme activate remastered
scripts.test: npm run env:start && npm run env:activate && npm run test:e2e
